claims.text: The authors present Xiaomi-GUI-0, a native multimodal GUI agent trained and evaluated in a real-device closed loop.

limitations.text: The evidence is the authors' arXiv paper/model card and reported evaluations; results are not independently reproduced in this Evidence review.

targets.finding: Xiaomi-GUI-0 uses a real-device-dominant closed-loop data/training/evaluation setup and reports results on an in-house RealMobile benchmark plus AndroidWorld.
